caption: The image shows a round plate with a reddish-brown background. The main design on the plate features a stylized bird, likely a parrot, outlined in green with a pattern of pale spots on its head, neck, and body. The bird is perched and facing toward the left, with a curved beak and elongated tail feathers. Surrounding the bird, there are several floral and leaf motifs, also in green, with some flowers featuring circular patterns and multiple petals. The rim of the plate has a thin, slightly darker brown border. The plate is depicted against a plain, off-white background, and there is a signature in red near the bottom right of the plate reading "M. L. Antonins."
title: Pa. German Pie Dish
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
